name: Real Life catalog
generatedFrom: real-life-org/meta and rltp-spec — do not edit by hand, run scripts/generate-pages.mjs

definition.de: Wiederkehrender Begegnungsraum. Wählt Form und Zugang selbst. Kreise verbinden sich durch Menschen, nicht durch übergeordnete Kreise.
definition.en: A recurring space of encounter. Chooses its own form and access. Circles connect through people, not through parent circles.

entries.note: Converged 2026-09-18: a circle is the thing itself; the Stack constructs it as a space, the Trust Protocol as a group. A circle chooses its own form and access, and the space carries exactly that: publicly visible, open for anyone to post, or by invitation. "Space" in the RLNP text is a reference to the Stack space, not a term of its own.

definition.de: Keine Eigenschaft einer Sache, sondern Folge davon, wo sie liegt. Drei Wege: in einem Kreis; gespiegelt, also zusätzlich lesbar in einem weiteren Kreis oder bei einem einzelnen Menschen, geändert nur am Ursprung; veröffentlicht, lesbar ohne Identität und Zugehörigkeit. Wer eine Sache teilt, soll vorher sehen, wen sie erreicht.
definition.en: Not a property of a thing but a consequence of where it lies. Three ways: within one circle; mirrored, that is additionally readable in a further circle or by a single person, changed only at its origin; published, readable without identity or membership. Whoever shares a thing should see beforehand whom it reaches.

entries.note: Three reaches, three constructions: "within one circle" is RLTP private; "within several circles" is the Stack's item in several spaces (the RLTP connector builds it as a mirror); "published" is RLTP open at the origin, delivery of open data needs another backend (multi-connector). VisibilityMode covers the first and third only.

definition.de: Kleinste Einheit des Netzwerks. Kenntlich nicht durch einen Verzeichniseintrag, sondern durch die, die ihn kennen. Die Identität gehört ihm selbst.
definition.en: The smallest unit of the network. Known not by a directory entry but by those who know them. Identity belongs to the person.

entries.note: Deliberately no exactMatch: RLTP has no person object, only anchors per context. This is by design (relationships never converge into a person). The profile is the view of a person, not the person.

definition.de: Soziale Verbindung zwischen Menschen oder zwischen Menschen und Agenten. Entsteht durch Begegnung, Kommunikation, Zusammenarbeit oder geteilte Erfahrung.
definition.en: A social connection between people, or between people and agents. Arises from encounter, communication, collaboration or shared experience.

entries.note: Decided 2026-09-18 (for now): an RLNP relationship is broader than an RLTP edge. Two kinds: person–person is an edge from an encounter (RLTP Edge); person–agent is an edge from appointment or vouching (future attestation). Proposal to RLNP 6.2: name both kinds. Relation (Stack) links items, not people: false friend.

definition.de: Zwei Menschen begegnen sich, real oder digital, tauschen aus, wer sie sind, und bleiben verbunden, wenn es stimmig ist. Begegnung wiederholt sich und ist der Normalfall des Netzwerks: Ein Mensch wird Teil davon, sobald er in Beziehung tritt.
definition.en: Two people meet, in person or digitally, exchange who they are, and stay connected if it fits. Encounters repeat and are the normal case of the network: a person becomes part of it the moment they enter a relationship.

entries.note: The event itself, repeated and ordinary, deliberately without counterpart in the Stack or the Trust Protocol: the encounter belongs to the people. Verification is the one-time act that records the relationship; later encounters need none.

definition.de: Die Bestätigung zweier Menschen, dass sie einander als diese Person erlebt haben, bei einer Begegnung und optional digital verifiziert. Bedeutet nicht allgemeine Vertrauenswürdigkeit, sondern nur, dass eine Begegnung oder Identitätsbeziehung bestätigt wurde.
definition.en: Two people's confirmation that they have met each other as this person, at an encounter and optionally verified digitally. Does not mean general trustworthiness, only that an encounter or identity relationship has been confirmed.

entries.note: One act in three parts (2026-09-18): the encounter happens in the network, the Stack verifies it in the app, the Trust Protocol constructs that verification as an enactment; the encounter credential is its result. Socially it happens once per relationship; the protocol allows repeated enactments, each with a fresh anchor, all landing on the same edge.

definition.de: Würdigen, was ein Mensch getan oder eingebracht hat. Anerkennung, keine Abnahme. Die bezeugte Person entscheidet über die Anzeige, nicht über die Aussage.
definition.en: Honouring what a person did or contributed. Recognition, not approval. The person witnessed decides about display, not about the statement.

entries.note: Target: a general attestation type in RLTP (candidate: DTG Endorsement Credential). Until then only the encounter has an artifact.

definition.de: Verantwortung, die ein Mensch gegenüber einem Kreis übernimmt. Sagt zu, dass etwas geschieht. Freiwillig, zurückgebbar, kein Rang.
definition.en: Responsibility a person takes on toward a circle. A promise that something happens. Voluntary, returnable, not a rank.

entries.note: A role taken on is a witnessed promise (RLNP 6.18, 8.13). Depends on the attestation type.

definition.de: Kollektiver Akteur mit Mitgliedern, Policy, Autoritäts-Log und Dokumenten. Identität ist der Digest der Genesis-Operation, Adresse die Gruppen-DID.
definition.en: A collective actor with members, a policy, an authority log, and documents. Its identity is the digest of its genesis operation; its address is its group DID.

definition.de: Zustand im Autoritäts-Log plus Schlüsselbesitz, kein Zertifikat. Eintritt nur durch explizite, kryptografisch gebundene Zustimmung.
definition.en: A fact in the authority log plus key possession, not a certificate. Entered only by explicit, cryptographically bound consent.

entries.note: Deliberately without a counterpart in RLNP (2026-09-18): the network knows membership only as what it must not require. Belonging to the network lives in relationships, not in lists; a circle chooses its own form and access, and membership is one of the forms the Stack and the Trust Protocol provide for it.

definition.de: Kennung einer Person gegenüber einem Kontext (did:key). Jede Durchführung einer Zeremonie läuft unter einem frisch abgeleiteten Paaranker, auch eine Wiederbegegnung; ein stehender Anker erscheint nie auf dem Zeremoniedraht, und Anker laufen nie zu einer Person zusammen.
definition.en: A person's identifier toward one context (did:key). Every enactment of a ceremony runs under a freshly derived pair anchor, a re-encounter too; a standing anchor never appears on the ceremony wire, and anchors never converge into a person.

definition.de: Die Relation zwischen zwei Ankern, gebildet aus den Begegnungs-Credentials zwischen ihnen; eingehend, ausgehend oder beidseitig. Eine Kante je Ankerpaar.
definition.en: The relation between two anchors constituted by the encounter credentials between them; incoming, outgoing, or mutual. One edge per anchor pair.

definition.de: Unveränderliches Credential, in dem eine Partei festhält, dass sie eine andere erkannt hat. Ausgestellt von einer Partei über die andere, offline prüfbar.
definition.en: The immutable credential in which one party records that they recognized another. Issued by one party about the other, verifiable offline.

definition.de: Der Modus, in dem eine Gruppe nach außen lesbar ist; Veröffentlichung läuft über den Publikations-Port (offene Sichtbarkeit: weltlesbar).
definition.en: The mode in which a group is readable from outside; publication runs through the publication port (open visibility: world-readable).

definition.de: Ein durchgeführter Lauf einer Zeremonie zwischen zwei Menschen. Nie wiederverwendet; vollständig, wenn beide Seiten ihre Aufzeichnung halten.
definition.en: One performed run of a ceremony between two people. Never reused; complete when both parties hold records.

definition.de: Ein für einen Begegnungsvorgang abgeleiteter Anker (DTG-Scope pairwise). Der Anker, unter dem eine Zeremonie durchgeführt wird, ist bei jedem Vorgang ein frischer Paaranker.
definition.en: An anchor derived for one enactment (DTG scope pairwise). The enacting anchor of a ceremony is a fresh pair anchor at every enactment.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the fresh anchor a person uses for one enactment is pure protocol construction; for the person it is still the one relationship (RLNP Beziehung, mapped at rltp:Edge).

definition.de: Signierte Selbstbeschreibung einer Person mit dem Material, um sie zu erkennen und zu erreichen, und im Begegnungsvorgang mit einer frischen Challenge; angezeigt (zum Scannen) oder gesendet (im Vorgang übertragen, nennt den Empfänger). Kein Credential.
definition.en: A person's signed self-description carrying the material needed to recognize and reach them and, in an enactment, a fresh challenge; displayed (shown for scanning) or sent (transmitted inside an enactment, naming its recipient). Not a credential.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the card carries what the counterpart needs to reach and recognize an anchor; the Stack shows a profile, which is the view of a person, not a delivery address.

definition.de: Frischer, einmal verwendbarer Wert hoher Entropie, der in einer Kontaktkarte für einen Begegnungsvorgang reist. Ein Begriff; angezeigte und gesendete Karten unterscheiden sich nur im Lebenszyklus.
definition.en: A fresh, single-use, high-entropy value carried in a contact card for one enactment. One concept; displayed and sent cards differ only in lifecycle.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the fresh value each party shows during an enactment is a construction detail of the verification (mapped at rltp:Enactment).

definition.de: Registrierte, versionierte Definition einer Begegnungsinteraktion einschließlich ihrer Zeitparameter.
definition.en: A registered, versioned definition of an encounter interaction, including its time parameters.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the registered form of an enactment (how the two parties see each other's challenges) is a construction detail of the verification (mapped at rltp:Enactment).

definition.de: Eine Credential-Ausstellung innerhalb eines Begegnungsvorgangs.
definition.en: One credential issuance within an enactment.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: one party's confirmation inside an enactment is a construction detail of the verification; the Stack and RLNP see the whole act.

definition.de: Der in beiden Schritt-Credentials eines Vorgangs identische Digest, der sie an einen Austauschdeskriptor bindet: Multihash über JCS von Zeremonie und beiden Challenges in aufsteigender Ordnung.
definition.en: The digest, identical in both step credentials of an enactment, that ties them to one exchange descriptor: the multihash over JCS of the ceremony and both challenges in ascending order.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the digest that ties the two challenges together is construction, invisible to the person.

definition.de: Die dauerhafte lokale Aufzeichnung einer Partei über einen Begegnungsvorgang, vor der Ausstellung angelegt; die Aufzeichnungen sind zugleich die Geschichte verbrauchter Challenges.
definition.en: A party's durable local record of an enactment, created before issuing; the records are also the consumed-challenge history.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: what a party keeps after its own step is local state of the protocol, not a thing in the network.

definition.de: Der multibase-kodierte Multihash über JCS des vollständigen Credentials einschließlich seines Proofs.
definition.en: The multibase-encoded multihash over JCS of the complete credential including its proof.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the content digest of an encounter credential is construction, invisible to the person.

definition.de: Die Ein-Scan-Übertragung (gesendete Karte plus Schritt-Credential), spezifiziert als Delivery-Contract-Task encounter-bundle.
definition.en: The one-scan transmission (sent card plus step credential), specified as the Delivery Contract task encounter-bundle.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the delivery unit of the one-scan path is construction of the transport, invisible to the person.

definition.de: Eine Kante aus lokaler Sicht, wenn die Partei ein Credential der Gegenseite angenommen und selbst keines ausgestellt hat.
definition.en: An edge, from a party's local view, when it has received the counterparty's credential and not issued its own.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: a direction state of rltp:Edge (only the counterpart has confirmed). For the person it is an unfinished verification; the Stack shows it as pending, not as a relationship.

definition.de: Eine Kante aus lokaler Sicht, wenn die Partei ihr Credential ausgestellt und keines der Gegenseite angenommen hat.
definition.en: An edge, from a party's local view, when it has issued its own credential and not received the counterparty's.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: a direction state of rltp:Edge (only this party has confirmed). For the person it is an unfinished verification; the Stack shows it as pending, not as a relationship.

definition.de: Eine Kante aus lokaler Sicht, wenn die Partei für mindestens einen Vorgang sowohl ausgestellt als auch angenommen hat.
definition.en: An edge, from a party's local view, when for at least one enactment it has both issued and received.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the state of rltp:Edge in which both parties have confirmed; this is the state RLNP Beziehung maps to.

definition.de: Der Teil der Zugangsschicht, der über Mitgliedschaft, Policy und Berechtigung entscheidet: Log, Materialisierung, Konfliktmatrix, Policy, Sichten. Nicht durch einen Adapter ersetzbar.
definition.en: The part of the Access Layer that decides membership, policy and authorization: log, materialization, conflict matrix, policy, views. Not replaceable by an adapter.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the part of the Access Layer that decides membership, policy and authorization is internal protocol architecture. The person sees a circle and its members; the Stack sees a space (rltp:Group).

definition.de: Die Schnittstelle, über die ein registrierter Adapter Epochengeheimnisse erzeugt, die die Invarianten KV1 bis KV6 erfüllen.
definition.en: The interface through which a registered adapter produces epoch secrets satisfying the invariants KV1 to KV6.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the interface through which an adapter produces epoch secrets is internal protocol architecture, invisible to the person and below the Stack's connector.

definition.de: Die Korrektur der Schlüsselstruktur durch den Schlüssel-Port an die materialisierte Mitgliedschaft; das Log entscheidet, die Schlüssel folgen.
definition.en: The key port's correction of its key structure to the materialized membership; the log decides, the keys follow.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the key port's correction of its key structure to the materialized membership is internal key management. For the person and the Stack membership simply holds.

definition.de: Der gruppenspezifische Kontextanker, unter dem ein Mitglied in einer Gruppe handelt (DTG-Geltungsbereich directed).
definition.en: The per-group context anchor under which one member acts in one group (DTG scope directed).

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the per-group anchor under which a member acts is protocol construction, like every anchor (RLNP Mensch, related at rltp:Anchor). For the person it is still the one member of the circle (rls:member, mapped at rltp:Member).

definition.de: Der Anker der persönlichen Gemeinschaft einer Person, ein gewöhnlicher Mitgliedsanker nach Identity §6, der als selbstgewählte beziehungsübergreifende Koordinate der Person dient; er erscheint in keinem Artefakt der Zugangsschicht außer innerhalb von member-mapping@1.
definition.en: The anchor of a person's personal community, an ordinary member anchor of Identity §6, serving as the person's chosen cross-relationship coordinate; it appears in no artifact of the Access Layer except inside member-mapping@1.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: an ordinary member anchor that a person uses as a chosen cross-relationship coordinate is protocol construction, like every anchor (RLNP Mensch, related at rltp:Anchor). The Stack shows a profile, which is the view of a person, not an anchor.

definition.de: Die signierte Bindung des Schlüsselmaterials eines Geräts an den Mitgliedsanker der Person, der es gehört; steht im Autoritäts-Log.
definition.en: The signed binding of one device's key material to the member anchor of the person it belongs to; recorded in the authority log.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the signed binding of a device's key material to a member anchor is protocol construction. Neither RLNP nor the Stack distinguish a person's devices.

definition.de: Eine Partei, die die Einträge einer Gruppe speichert und weiterleitet, ohne ihre Schlüssel zu halten; ihre Klasse (blind, view, log) ist die registrierte Aussage darüber, was sie von der Gruppe weiß.
definition.en: A party that stores and forwards a group's items without holding its keys; its class (blind, view, log) is the registered statement of what it knows of the group.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: a party that stores and forwards a group's items without holding its keys is protocol infrastructure. The network knows only people and circles; the Stack's connector is the app-side access to a backend, not a party the group registers.

definition.de: Die bei der Registrierung erklärte Aussage, was ein Dienst von einer Gruppe weiß: blind (nur Chiffrat), view (auch Berechtigungssichten) oder log (auch das Autoritäts-Log). Die Wahl trifft die Gruppe.
definition.en: The statement, declared at registration, of what a service knows of a group: blind (ciphertext only), view (also authorization views) or log (also the authority log). The group chooses.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: what a service knows of a group (blind, view, log) is a registered protocol statement about rltp:Service, invisible to the person and the Stack.

definition.de: Der nur anwachsende Operations-DAG, der in der Genesis-Operation wurzelt; die einzige Quelle des Berechtigungszustands.
definition.en: The append-only operation DAG rooted in the genesis operation; the sole source of authorization state.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the append-only operation DAG that is the sole source of authorization state is protocol construction. The person sees who belongs to the circle; the Stack sees the members of a space.

definition.de: Ein signierter, kausal verankerter Umschlag.
definition.en: A signed, causally anchored envelope.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: a signed, causally anchored envelope in the authority log is protocol construction, invisible to the person and the Stack.

definition.de: Die deterministische Ableitung des Gruppenzustands aus dem Log; ihr Ergebnis ist der materialisierte Zustand.
definition.en: The deterministic derivation of group state from the log; its result is the materialized state.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the deterministic derivation of group state from the log is protocol construction. The person and the Stack see only its result: the circle or space with its members.

definition.de: Eine Operation ist kanonisch, wenn die Materialisierung an ihrer kausalen Position sie annimmt und keine Ergebnisregel aus 3.6 über sie verfügt.
definition.en: An operation is canonical when materialization at its causal position accepts it and no outcome rule of 3.6 disposes of it.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: whether materialization accepts an operation at its causal position is a property inside the protocol's conflict resolution, invisible to the person and the Stack.

definition.de: Die Menge der Parteien, die das replizierte Log der Gruppe bei einem gegebenen materialisierten Zustand halten und halten dürfen.
definition.en: The set of parties holding, and entitled to hold, the group's replicated log at a given materialized state.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the set of parties entitled to hold the group's replicated log is protocol construction. RLNP Sichtbarkeit is about what a person shows to whom, not about who stores the log.

definition.de: Der Gruppenzustand, den die deterministische Ableitung aus dem Log ergibt (Materialisierung).
definition.en: The group state yielded by materialization, the deterministic derivation of group state from the log.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the group state yielded by materialization is protocol construction; the person sees the circle, the Stack the space (rltp:Group), not a derived state.

definition.de: Das ausfallsichere Ergebnis der Materialisierung bei den Gabel-Paarungen aus 3.6: eine Policy-Änderung oder eine Auflösung nebenläufig zu einer Durchsetzungsoperation.
definition.en: The fail-closed materialization outcome of the fork pairings that 3.6 names: a policy change or a dissolution concurrent with an enforcement operation.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: a fail-closed outcome of materialization and a narrower case of rltp:MaterializedState, arising when a policy change or dissolution runs concurrent with an enforcement operation. It is conflict handling inside the protocol, invisible to the person and the Stack.

definition.de: Die normativ berechnete Menge der Mitglieder, die das neue Epochengeheimnis einer Durchsetzungsoperation erreicht.
definition.en: The normatively computed set of members an enforcement operation’s new epoch secret reaches.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the computed set of members an enforcement operation's new epoch secret reaches is key-management construction. For the person and the Stack the circle simply keeps its members (rls:member, mapped at rltp:Member).

definition.de: Der Zustand eines Mitglieds, dessen member.leave gemergt ist, dessen entlastender Übergang aber noch nicht.
definition.en: The state of a member whose member.leave has merged but whose discharging transition has not.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the state between a merged member.leave and its discharging transition is protocol construction. For the person leaving a circle is one act; the Stack has no intermediate state for it.

definition.de: Gruppendefinierte Daten, die je Regelschlüssel angeben, welcher Nachweis die Entscheidungsregel der Gruppe erfüllt.
definition.en: Group-defined data stating, per rule key, which proof satisfies the group’s decision rule.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: group-defined data stating which proof satisfies the group's decision rule is protocol construction. RLNP lets a circle choose its own form and decisions without encoding them as rules; the Stack has no policy object.

definition.de: Das Material, an dem eine Operation gegen ihre Regel geprüft wird: die Menge ihrer Unterzeichner und die Menge der zulässigen Bürgschaften.
definition.en: The material an operation is judged by against its rule: its signer set and its admissible vouch set.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the signer set and vouch set an operation is judged by is construction of rltp:Policy, invisible to the person and the Stack.

definition.de: Die stehende Pflicht der Mitglieder, einer Partei, der der materialisierte Zustand es zuspricht, prüfbares Schlüsselmaterial der aktuellen Epoche (erneut) zuzustellen.
definition.en: The standing obligation of members to (re)deliver verifiable current-epoch key material to a party the materialized state entitles to it.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the members' standing obligation to (re)deliver current-epoch key material is a duty inside the protocol's key management. For the person and the Stack entitled members simply can read.

definition.de: Ein nummerierter Abschnitt der Schlüsselwelt der Gruppe; Durchsetzung wirkt als Epochenübergang. Begriff wie in MLS (RFC 9420).
definition.en: A numbered period of the group’s key world; enforcement takes effect as epoch transitions. Term aligned with MLS (RFC 9420).

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: a numbered period of the group's key world, aligned with MLS, is key-management construction. Neither RLNP nor the Stack divide a circle or space into key periods.

definition.de: Die Kette der Einträge je Übergang, mit der der Adapter linear/0.1 einen früheren Inhaltsschlüssel unter dem nächsten lesbar macht.
definition.en: The chain of per-transition entries by which the adapter linear/0.1 makes a previous content key readable under the next.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the chain of per-transition entries by which the adapter linear/0.1 keeps earlier content keys readable is construction of one adapter (rltp:Adapter), invisible to the person and the Stack.

definition.de: Das verkettete, per Quorum signierte Objekt, durch das ein Dienst der Klasse view die Epoche und die berechtigten Geräte-Identitäten einer Gruppe erfährt.
definition.en: The chained, quorum-signed object by which a service of class view learns a group’s epoch and authorized device identities.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the quorum-signed object by which a service of class view learns a group's epoch and authorized devices is protocol infrastructure (rltp:Service), invisible to the person and the Stack.

definition.de: Eine Operation des geschlossenen Katalogs, jede mit Klasse (additiv, Durchsetzung, terminal), Epochenwirkung und geschlossenem Body-Profil.
definition.en: An operation of the closed catalog, each with its class (additive, enforcement, terminal), epoch effect and closed body profile.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: an operation of the closed catalog and a narrower case of rltp:Operation, each with its class, epoch effect and body profile. Admitting or removing a member is one act for the person and the Stack; the operation is its construction.

definition.de: Das Lese- und Schreibrecht, das jedes Mitglied allein durch die Mitgliedschaft hat.
definition.en: The read/write standing every member holds by membership alone.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: the read/write standing every member holds by membership alone is how the protocol states that belonging is enough. The Stack expresses it through membership itself (rls:member, mapped at rltp:Member); RLNP knows no membership list to attach it to.

definition.de: Eine registrierte Bindung eines Schlüsselvereinbarungsverfahrens an den Schlüssel-Port.
definition.en: A registered binding of one key-agreement procedure to the key port.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or the Stack: a registered binding of a key-agreement procedure to the key port is internal protocol architecture, invisible to the person. The Stack's backend binding is the connector, which is pure Stack construction and unrelated.

definition.de: Vorgeschlagen: signierte, portable Aussage einer Person über Beitrag, Rolle, Fähigkeit oder Versprechen einer anderen, unabhängig prüfbar. Kandidat: Verifiable Endorsement Credential (VEC) der DTG, also ein Statement Credential mit dem Prädikat endorses/1.
definition.en: Proposed: a signed, portable statement by one person about another's contribution, role, skill or promise, independently verifiable. Candidate: the DTG Verifiable Endorsement Credential (VEC), i.e. a Statement Credential with predicate endorses/1.

definition.de: Der gemeinsame Arbeits-, Mitgliedschafts- und Sichtbarkeitskontext. Im Datenvertrag heißt er Group.
definition.en: The shared context for work, membership and visibility. In the data contract it is called Group.

definition.de: Ein schreibgeschützter Schnappschuss eines Items in einem anderen Space als seinem Home. Er erscheint dort als gewöhnliches Item mit der Relation mirrorOf auf das Original; bearbeitet wird immer das Home. Dieselbe Form gilt für alle Connectoren: mit Signaturidentität (RLTP) sind die Schnappschüsse vom Autor signiert und werden vor der Anzeige geprüft, ohne Signaturidentität kommen sie ohne JWS aus einer Vertrauensdomäne.
definition.en: A read-only snapshot of an item in a space other than its home. There it appears as an ordinary item with the relation mirrorOf pointing at the original; editing always opens the home. The same form holds for every connector: with a signing identity (RLTP) the snapshots are author-signed and verified before they are shown, without one they come without a JWS from a single trust domain.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP or RLTP: for the person it is simply a thing in several spaces; the mirror exists because the Trust Protocol partitions storage by access boundary. The protocol itself knows only groups and their replication.

definition.de: Eine gerichtete Beziehung zwischen Items mit Prädikat und Ziel. Rückverweise zeigen sie aus der Gegenrichtung.
definition.en: A directed link between items with predicate and target. Back-references show it from the opposite direction.

definition.de: Die fachliche Darstellung einer Person als Item nach Profilvertrag. Die User-Identität ist ein eigener Begriff.
definition.en: The domain representation of a person as an item under the profile contract. The user identity is a separate term.

definition.de: Die Implementierung des DataInterface für eine konkrete Datenquelle, ergänzt um unterstützte Capabilities. Die Steckstelle des Stacks nach unten.
definition.en: The implementation of the DataInterface for one data source, plus the capabilities it supports. The stack's socket downward.

entries.note: Deliberately without counterpart in RLNP and RLTP. The connector is pure Stack construction.

definition.de: Vorgeschlagen: wer zu einem Space gehört. Die Anwendungsschicht liest Mitgliedschaft über den Connector und konstruiert sie nicht selbst; wie sie gespeichert und belegt wird, entscheidet der jeweilige Connector (der lokale Connector hält sie in groupMembers, der RLTP-Connector leitet sie aus Gruppen-Log und Schlüssel ab).
definition.en: Proposed: who belongs to a space. The application layer reads membership through the connector and does not construct it; how it is stored and proven is decided by the connector in use (the local connector keeps it in groupMembers, the RLTP connector derives it from the group log and key).

definition.de: Vorgeschlagen: wo ein Item liegt und wer es deshalb sieht: im Space, gespiegelt in einen anderen Space, oder veröffentlicht ohne Anmeldung. Welches Backend ein veröffentlichtes Item ausliefert, entscheidet der Connector.
definition.en: Proposed: where an item lives and who therefore sees it: within its space, mirrored into another space, or published without sign-in. Which backend serves a published item is the connector's decision.

definition.de: Der Ablauf, in dem zwei Menschen eine Begegnung in der App festhalten, etwa per QR-Code; eine eigene Capability des Connectors. Kontakte und Verifikationen sind nicht dasselbe wie Profile.
definition.en: The flow in which two people record an encounter in the app, for example by QR code; a capability of the connector in its own right. Contacts and verifications are not the same as profiles.

definition.de: Vorgeschlagen: ein Item liegt in mehr als einem Space und hat einen Heimat-Space, der es verantwortet. Wie das gemacht wird, per Zuordnung in einer zentralen Datenbank oder per Kopie mit Brücke bei verteilten Gruppen, entscheidet der Connector.
definition.en: Proposed: an item lies in more than one space and has a home space responsible for it. How this is done, by association in a central database or by copy with a bridge across distributed groups, is the connector's decision.
the multibase multihash over JCS(document) of a delivery document's plaintext; its identity for idempotency and acknowledgement
the encrypted form in which a document travels: ephemeral X25519, HKDF, AES-256-GCM
the receiver's classification of a processed envelope (staged, first failing stage names it)
the arrival acknowledgement: machine-generated at the durable recording of a document's defined effect; arrival, never acceptance
The generic carrier for Access-layer operations crossing the replica boundary, incl. the member.add admission profile and the welcome seal.
The arrival acknowledgement: proof-carrying, terminal, arrival-only semantics.
The one-scan transmission: the scanner's sent card and step credential.
Post-enactment delivery of a step credential (counter-step or standalone).
Epoch key material to a specific party, and the authenticated request for it: transition key envelopes, welcomes and re-welcomes, refreshes under the key service duty.
The consent artifact: signed by the person consenting, subject equals issuer and the invite's invitee, content-bound by credential digest to exactly one invitation.
The evidence relay: the complete invite and accept documents, enclosed, so any authorized member can admit.
The invitation as a conformant DTG InvitationCredential: issued by the inviting member, subject is the invitee, no key material; bound to the membership thread.
Per-party declaration of fixed operational constants for a served role; the envelope is generic, each role's specification registers the constant names.
The compact notice a removed member is owed: it states the removal without carrying the transition-bearing envelope, which never crosses the replica boundary.

definition.de: Zurückgezogene Version, abgelöst durch membership-invite/0.2. Die Kennung löst weiter auf, das veröffentlichte Schema bleibt.
definition.en: Retired version, superseded by membership-invite/0.2. The URI keeps resolving; the published schema stays.

definition.de: Zurückgezogene Version, abgelöst durch membership-accept/0.2. Die Kennung löst weiter auf, das veröffentlichte Schema bleibt.
definition.en: Retired version, superseded by membership-accept/0.2. The URI keeps resolving; the published schema stays.
The target state: these two concepts are meant to become the same, and the specifications have a task until they are. The SKOS mapping relations describe today.
definition.de: Der Zielzustand: Diese zwei Begriffe sollen gleich werden, und die Spezifikationen haben eine Aufgabe, bis sie es sind. Die SKOS-Relationen beschreiben das Heute.

definition.en: Same word in at least one language, different thing, on purpose. Recorded so the pair is never reported as a missing mapping and so the pages show it explicitly.
definition.de: Gleiches Wort in mindestens einer Sprache, andere Sache, mit Absicht. Festgehalten, damit das Paar nie als fehlende Verknüpfung gemeldet wird und die Seiten es ausdrücklich zeigen.

definition.en: "proposed": the concept does not exist in its specification yet; it is a proposal from the register to that part.
definition.de: „proposed": Der Begriff existiert in seiner Spezifikation noch nicht; er ist ein Vorschlag des Registers an diesen Teil.

definition.en: Code symbols that implement the term (Real Life Stack only).
definition.de: Codesymbole, die den Begriff implementieren (nur Real Life Stack).
